purpose: Define the conditions under which a property evidence fixture impact event and its revalidation queue item may be formally closed.
required_conditions: The fixture version used for revalidation is approved or otherwise explicitly permitted by its lifecycle.
Every required dependent test has a new validation result.
The new validation run is distinct from historical runs.
Required provenance and privacy checks pass.
Affected pathway validation status has been recalculated.
The resulting validation run IDs are linked to the impact event and queue item.
No unresolved critical fixture dependency remains.
Closure does not automatically change legal-source verification or publication status.
guardrails: Closure is a technical evidence-governance state, not a legal conclusion.
Closing a fixture impact event cannot establish real ownership, title, boundary or other property facts.
A closed technical impact event does not make a pathway publication-ready by itself.
Historical validation runs cannot be rewritten during closure.
